'''Hirra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corporal Hirra appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Nar Shaddaa Equipment Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
